scope: Independent analysis of the one actual current-source synthetic Chinese case and its original raw bytes. No replay, model invocation, code or input modification.

batch_scope.per_target_full_raw_review: Only Chinese complete raw and SFU/Chinese gate receipts are present in this small package. The remaining raw target and runner receipts will be audited from the separate full export; they are not fabricated here.

espeak.algorithm: sorted relative UTF-8 filename + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 hex ASCII + LF

media_before.scope: Mutable test-owned capture state, deliberately excluded from immutable model equality.

media_after.scope: Mutable test-owned capture state, deliberately excluded from immutable model equality.

outer_cleanup.scope: Signals target only the owned process group. Actual leader reap and non-atomic group observations are recorded; this is not a claim that all descendants were individually joined.

actual_test.reached_shutdown: The unchanged function awaits speech.shutdown after its eight records and non-empty/retention checks. The exact case and original process both returned success. This is not a physical-device or production-owner shutdown qualification.

raw_handling.extraction: Only complete JSON-prefixed byte lines are strictly UTF-8 decoded. Original byte ranges and line SHA-256 are recorded. No lossy decoding or replacement was applied to transcript strings.

derived_quality_diagnostic.measurement_policy: Unicode codepoint Levenshtein distance after removing only Unicode punctuation categories P* and whitespace. No traditional/simplified folding, case folding, NFKC, spelling correction or alternative-reference selection.
derived_quality_diagnostic.observed_error: Both clean and noisy versions of the second sentence transcribe 会话 as 挥话.
derived_quality_diagnostic.attribution_limit: These outputs describe the fixed Piper-to-resampler-to-Whisper chain. They do not isolate whether pronunciation or recognition caused the difference.

timing.statistics_definition: The unchanged test sorts eight STT samples and uses index 3 as p50 and index 7 as both p95 and p99. These eight-sample order statistics are not population tail-latency guarantees.
timing.stt_clock_scope: Starts immediately before submit_with_source and stops after its result; excludes Piper synthesis, prior resampling, later explicit source verify/release and final LocalSpeech shutdown.
timing.cargo_compile_report: Finished test profile in 1m 19s, as rounded by Cargo.
timing.captured_duration_limit: This case does not print captured PCM lengths/durations. No audio real-time factor or mic-to-speaker latency can be computed from these raw JSON samples.
timing.decoder_padding: The unchanged test adds one second (32000 bytes) of zero PCM decoder padding while retaining/verifying only the captured pre-padding byte count.

quality_boundary: Eight records are four fixed synthetic utterances each with clean and deterministic low-amplitude white-noise input; they are not eight independent human speakers or eight test cases.
The unchanged acceptance assertion requires nonempty recognized text and exact retained-source integrity/release, not an accuracy threshold. Passing it does not imply every word was correct.
The synthetic noise is not measured acoustic echo. No physical microphone, OS permission, unplug/revoke recovery, audible speaker output or real Hepta owner/thread/grants was qualified.
The separate authorized AISHELL recording uses the fixed base Whisper configuration. It must not be merged with these small-q5_1 synthetic results or counted before its actual output arrives.
